plans.idea: Keep the original's centred vertical story at full width: logo pill on top, a much larger sneaker, then a wide text block so the headline and subline read big, with the Enter the Draw pill centred under its copy and the whole stack centred top to bottom so there is no dead band at the bottom.

Put the headline first: logo, then a large type block at the top so the headline is the first thing seen, then the sneaker as a big full-width product moment, ending on a centred CTA pill that closes the read before the swipe.

Lead with the product: the sneaker sits big across the top third, the headline, subline and CTA form one tight centred block below it, and the VOLTSTRIDE logo pill signs off at the bottom edge to anchor the tall frame.
